summary_en: 422,000 shares (1.21% of S/O) to be acquired by open market over ¥500M limit between 2026/08/10 and 2026/09/17. Rationale: flexible capital allocation and 50% total payout ratio target, in addition to interim dividend of ¥32/share announced same date.
summary_jp: 422,000株（発行済株式総数（自己株式除く）に対する1.21%）を上限5億円で2026年8月10日～9月17日に取得。資本効率向上と同日発表の32円中間配当に加え、総還元性向50%の達成が狙い。
